name: Banh beo
summary: The culture office names bánh bèo at the Don An Phú festival and does not describe it. ZaloPay says the Quảng Ngãi cake has a thicker batter than the Hue cake, a shrimp-and-pork topping, and a small aluminum spoon.
howToEat: ZaloPay: a thicker rice batter than the Hue cake, a topping of shrimp and minced pork, and fish sauce. Eaten with a small aluminum spoon, sauce poured on the hot cake.
The culture office names bánh bèo and does not describe the batter or the spoon.
No street, no hour, and no price were printed. The hour is Check on arrival.
where: The festival ground is south of cầu Cổ Lũy, thôn Phú Thọ. ZaloPay names no street number.
seoDescription: Bánh bèo named at the Don An Phú festival. ZaloPay describes a thicker batter and a shrimp-and-pork topping. Price and hour are Check on arrival.
